fields.name: IActivator<TModel>
fields.contract: IActivator<TModel> is a static activation contract for a TModel grain model. An implementing model type provides `Activatate<Tmodel>(string grainType, ReadOnlyMemory<byte> key)`, which returns the activated TModel instance. It receives the grain's binary key and, despite the parameter's name, the state name the storage provider was called with: Orleans' IGrainStorage stateName, which is the literal "state" for every Grain<TState> or the name given to [PersistentState], not the grain type. ArgentSea's grain persistence (ArgentSeaDbGrainPersistence and ArgentSeaShardGrainPersistence) calls this factory when a grain read returns no record and the grain state type implements IActivator<TModel>, and the instance it returns becomes the grain state (with RecordExists false); the call goes through an internal GrainStateActivator that caches one constrained-generic delegate per TModel. For a state type that does not implement the interface, the providers instead create a default instance with its public parameterless constructor and set its key values from the grain id. A type that implements IActivator<TModel> needs no public parameterless constructor under Orleans: Orleans' storage bridge supplies a non-null initial state from its own activator before calling the read, so the providers' parameterless-constructor fallback for a null supplied state is not reached.
